title: Finding the Right Childcare: Guilt-Free Guide for Working Moms
description:
🎙️ PODCAST EPISODE 7 DROPS TOMORROW at 4PM!

We’re so excited to share this meaningful conversation with our special guest, Mrs. Mary Sue Watson — my amazing mother-in-law and a true expert in early childhood education with over 60 years of experience! 💛

✨ In today’s clip, here’s a heartfelt tip from Mrs. Mary Sue:
Let’s talk about how to find a childcare center — and the emotions that come with it.

👶 “Number one — don’t feel guilty that you’re leaving your little one.
Mamas feel so guilty, especially if you’re choosing to work. But the truth is, for many families, working isn’t a choice — it’s a necessity.
It’s part of life. The key is feeling comfortable with the leaving process — because that’s the hardest part.”

So much wisdom and reassurance for working moms.
🎧 Full episode goes live tomorrow at 4PM! Don’t miss it.
